messages.subject: Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() and I cannot find whu
parts:
Hi All, 
The codes below is causing my model to crash and I cannot understand why.
 
base.formula <- Incidence_mod ~ 1 + f(ID.City, model = "bym2", replicate = year, graph = W.City, scale.model = TRUE, diagonal = 1e-4) + f(month, replicate = ID.City, model = "rw2", cyclic = TRUE, constr = TRUE, scale.model = TRUE, diagonal = 1e-4)

model_inla_base <- inla(base.formula, data = data.valid, control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE), family="zeroinflatednbinomial1", control.inla=list(strategy="adaptive", int.strategy='eb', cmin=0), verbose=TRUE, control.compute=list(openmp.strategy="huge", dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE), control.fixed=list(prec=1, prec.intercept=1), num.threads=16, blas.num.threads=1)

1. Check that your year values are integers taking values 1,2,3,etc and not actual years.
2. Perhaps you have more replicates than in your previous models; space-time  models can quickly become very very large…

Thanks a lot for your help, my model is finally running after I changed year into 1,2,3,etc.

在2024年12月18日星期三 UTC+8 18:10:48<Finn Lindgren> 写道：
1. Check that your year values are integers taking values 1,2,3,etc and not actual years.
2. Perhaps you have more replicates than in your previous models; space-time  models can quickly become very very large…
Finn

On 18 Dec 2024, at 11:06, Yuchen Wang <ycwa...@gmail.com> wrote:

﻿The model without the part replicate = year   is using oddly too much time that I am not sure if there is still anything wrong.
The model has been keep running for over 4 hours and still hasn't reach a result.
I have used this kind of model formula in another research and it is much faster.

在2024年12月18日星期三 UTC+8 14:39:41<Yuchen Wang> 写道：
Thank you for answering.
I think I kind of locate the source of the error In my code
base.formula <- Incidence_mod ~ 1 +
  f(ID.City, model = "bym2", replicate = year, graph = W.City, scale.model = TRUE, diagonal=1e-4) +
  f(month, replicate = ID.City, model = "rw1", cyclic = TRUE, constr = TRUE, scale.model = TRUE, diagonal=1e-4)
I found the problem is in my spatial variable.
When I delete the marked part (replicate = year), the model processes just fine.
I am not really familiar with this method and I suppose that part allows the difference within different years maybe?
So how can I solve the problem? Thank you again.
